notes.title: Update 1.0.1.0
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41752357/f21f9da2f00f23cb64d321e07bee0d1a0d7a9ac8.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Short announcement[/b][/p][p]First of all, thank you for playing [i]Space Dragons[/i]. We’ve been fixing some of the bugs you’ve reported, and we’ve also been working on something exciting. We’re happy to announce that in a few weeks we’ll be releasing a major update with new content including a brand new pilot joining the fight against the alien threat![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41752357/15562294d3b98888b61341c0b687bc08b802196e.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Patch Notes 1.0.1.0:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed bugs in the final boss.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug in Boss 9.[/p][/*][*][p]Defeating Boss 9 now grants the upgrade panel.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved gameplay experience with minor adjustments.[/p][/*][*][p]Various tweaks to music and sound design (dialogues now include background music).[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41752357/fc0f3bbc5720d8e24f5d7d7a7b97bef20db8d5e2.png"][/img][/p][p]Remember that you can share any feedback you like through channels such as “meeting point” etc. Thank you very much for playing [i]Space Dragons[/i]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41752357/c3c8f3f66c95d49f87e65f18510f902cdcca0596.png"][/img][/p][p]TEAM Black Hat Robot[/p][p][url="https://www.teamblackhatrobot.com/"]teamblackhatrobot.com[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.1
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello, dear players,[/b][/p][p]We’ve been working all day on this update. We sincerely apologize to those who encountered issues in the final areas of the game, especially the one that prevented the final zone from displaying correctly.[/p][p]You can now complete the game without any problems!
Below are the patch notes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed access to the final stage. Some players reported being unable to enter this issue has been fully resolved, and the game can now be completed without any issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved various bugs related to graphics and resolution.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a sound issue that occurred in some levels, particularly in the final stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed several minor bugs reported by players.[/p][/*][/list][p]After this small update, we continue working on the next update that will bring more content.[/p][p]If you have any questions or want to give us feedback, please don't hesitate to use the available channels, such as the meeting point.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41752357/fc0f3bbc5720d8e24f5d7d7a7b97bef20db8d5e2.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for playing Space Dragons! :D[/p]

notes.title: Released
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41752357/f21f9da2f00f23cb64d321e07bee0d1a0d7a9ac8.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear players, we’ve finally released version 1.0 of Space Dragons, and that makes us incredibly happy. It’s been several years of development and a long Early Access period, but the content we’ve been working on for so long is now available — and there’s still more to come, which we’ll be revealing over the coming weeks.[/p][p][b]Fight your way through with your powerful and destructive combat spaceship, and lead the Last Hope squad through the ferocious alien invasion, commanded by the hive mind  the furious reincarnation of destruction that dwells on the Moon.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41752357/15471b358c179c497f52a2672d6e49db7ef3a4cd.png"][/img]You can play the campaign solo or in co-op with a friend, and create powerful ability combinations using the weapons and upgrades we've prepared for you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41752357/6a2622ef8149d7a525b4f80f8df85c8894c73db4.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41752357/5dc7d598b1311de4384772e58f55b4261ee131a3.png"][/img][/p][h3]Patch Notes[/h3][p]We've added new content and completed the [b]Space Dragons[/b] campaign. Here's what's new:[/p][list][*][p]Final [b]stage[/b] and boss added: it's a short level, but extremely intense. The final battle is truly epic.[/p][/*][*][p]General difficulty balancing.[/p][/*][*][p]New enemies added.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual adjustments and fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]New final stage upgrade[/p][/*][*][p]New cutscenes to better tell the story.[/p][/*][*][p]Added character dialogues — they’ll guide you through the story. You can fast-forward or skip them anytime.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes and technical improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p]…plus a few more surprises.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41752357/7508f768a056521c2a26896920e82bcb7ee7b1ea.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41752357/fc0f3bbc5720d8e24f5d7d7a7b97bef20db8d5e2.png"][/img][/p][p]We're very excited that you can finally play the full version of [b]Space Dragons[/b]!
But this is just the beginning — we’ve got many more surprises coming in the next few weeks. For example, we’re working on new end-of-level upgrades, and possibly a new pilot to join the [b]Last Hope[/b] squad.
Of course, we're also actively fixing any bugs that may appear.[/p][p]And very importantly, we will also soon add the new achievements to the game[/p][p]We’d really appreciate your feedback and any bug reports via the [b]Meetup Point[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41752357/c3c8f3f66c95d49f87e65f18510f902cdcca0596.png"][/img][/p][p]Much love to all of you!
More news coming soon.[/p][p][b]— Team Black Hat Robot[/b][/p]

notes.title: Release updated: August 2nd, 2025.
notes.notes: [p][b]Hi,[/b][/p][p]First of all, we want to sincerely apologize for having to delay the release of Space Dragons version 1.0 by a few days. We have been experiencing some issues with the Steam platform, and this has also slightly delayed the resolution of a few bugs found in the new content.[/p][p]We strive to be as transparent as possible with you, our beloved players, so we will keep you informed about everything that happens leading up to the launch.[/p][p]The new release date is [b]August 2nd, 2025.[/b][/p][p]We truly appreciate your understanding and support. We are working hard to deliver the best possible version of [b]Space Dragons.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41752357/fc0f3bbc5720d8e24f5d7d7a7b97bef20db8d5e2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Release Info
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41752357/f21f9da2f00f23cb64d321e07bee0d1a0d7a9ac8.png"][/img][/p][p]It’s been a long time since we last shared news about [b]Space Dragons[/b], and we apologize for that. The past two years have been very challenging for our team; both the artist and the programmer faced personal issues that kept us away from our PCs and from development. However, a couple of months ago we resumed work on all our games, including [b]Space Dragons[/b].[/p][p]We’re back and determined to deliver the best product possible.[/p][p]Our goal is to finally complete this game, incorporating much of the feedback you’ve given us and adding brand new content. We’ve even included a fierce, epic final boss so make sure you have enough credits, because the beast will show no mercy![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41752357/fc0f3bbc5720d8e24f5d7d7a7b97bef20db8d5e2.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ll release [b]version 1.0[/b] on [b]Thursday, July 31, 2025[/b]. This update will bring the final level, numerous bug fixes, graphical tweaks, and new content overall. A few days later, we plan to ship [b]version 1.1[/b], which will add even more content currently in development: upgrades for your ships and other surprises.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41752357/b0fb63f953edd4923db203b44cec31fe81ac1cb2.gif"][/img][/p][p]We invite you to play [b]Space Dragons[/b] and add it to your wishlist your support means the world to us! See you very soon.
Thank you, brave pilot and alien slayer![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/rDzc3KstDxc?si=qT1kLEHLgUAYZFdN"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: The end is near +new content!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41752357/f914264930db70c1d5e01acc9295a58bd95381d8.png[/img]
First, we want to mention that with this update we're very close to releasing version 1.0 of Space Dragons and taking it out of Early Access. In fact we're already working on the update that will bring the final stage and boss, along with many new things. We thank you infinitely for playing Space Dragons and giving us your feedback at the meeting point and social networks. We love seeing the gameplays that you publish playing Space Dragons, they really make us very happy.

During these months we have been working on many new things for you, Space Dragons is growing and adding very interesting things. Next we will talk about the new content.

[list]
[*] 2 new stages
[*] More new enemies
[*] Sounds update, we have also designed and added some really cool new sounds
[*] Gameplay Settings
[*] Fixed bugs and errors
[*] We're polishing the interface
[/list]

We hope you like the new update.

Seriusly, thank you very much for playing Space Dragons! <3

notes.title: Update v 0.2.3.0
notes.notes:
Hello, we're aware of the feedback that you are giving us, thank you very much for that, we really care a lot about the community. We have been improving control support and a few things we listed below.

[list]
[*] Enhanced controller support; You can use your ps4, xbox and generic controller. (we're working on having as much compatibility as possible, if you have any bugs with the new controller support please let us know)
[/list]
[list]
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]
[list]
[*] Solutions for the interface. Now you can play without the interface blocking your gameplay.
[/list]

We are working on new playable content and of course reading your feedback to improve Space Dragons. Thanks for playing! :D

notes.title: The first little update
notes.notes:
Thank you all for playing Space Dragons, we know that no game is exempt from small errors or bugs, we aren't the exception, however we're working very hard to solve each and every one of the errors.

[b]Before we start mentioning the solutions, we want to tell you that we are working on a big update that has new playable content. It will be available soon.[/b]

Below the fixes:

[list]
[*] Correction of the execution mechanic, now it works correctly on all enemies. (if you have a problem, let us know)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41752357/0475cc4a8f080d49df009338bae354d28061ec41.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Correction of the analog stick of the control, now you can control your ship with the left stick.
[/list]
[list]
[*] We sorted the leaderboards, now you can see all the positions by moving down (keyboard button "S" directional control "down").
[/list]
[list]
[*] Small graphics fix
[/list]
[list]
[*] Small bug fixes
[/list]
[list]
[*] Controller fixes
[/list]

Thanks for reading, see you soon!
